title: CSP instance induced by a tester
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let a finite predicate template specify each predicate’s arity and satisfaction rule, and let a uniform string tester have a finite nonempty seed space. The induced CSP instance contains, with multiplicity, one constraint for each seed, using that seed’s predicate and ordered tuple of distinct variables; every declared variable occurs in at least one such constraint.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate template over domain $D$ with finitely many predicates
Each seed selects a predicate and an ordered tuple of distinct variables of its arity
Every declared variable is queried by at least one seed
